h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rewa

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rewa

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rewa

c: Many smaller cities in Madhya Pradesh now have well-kept town parks and walking paths, and Rewa in the Vindhya region is among them. An outdoor gym added beside such a path gets used from the first morning. FunPlay Systems supplies open air gym equipment to Rewa, built at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,040 km away. We have been making outdoor play and fitness equipment since 2002, with more than 15,000 installations across India.

Our buyers in this part of the state are usually municipal bodies, schools, colleges and residential colonies. Each machine is a separate unit with its own foundation, made from galvanised pipe with moulded seats and handles. We dispatch by road and install with our team or a dealer, after you have approved a layout drawing that shows where every station goes.

richText.heading: Laying out stations along a walking path

c: Spread machines along the path in small groups of two or three rather than one long row. People can then stop at a cluster mid-walk without crowding the track. Put a cardio machine such as the

at the next, so each stop offers something different.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Should outdoor gym machines be grouped or spread out?
items.a: On a walking path, small clusters of two or three work well. People can stop mid-walk, and the track stays clear for others. We mark the clusters and their clear zones on the layout drawing.

items.q: Can you supply municipal parks in Madhya Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We supply parks, schools and colonies across the state. Share the site plan and photos, and we will send a layout and quotation.

items.q: How are the machines fixed to the ground?
items.a: Usually by grouting the posts into a concrete base. On some paved surfaces a self-standing frame can be used instead. We decide after seeing photos of the ground.
